# Minimalist Theme

Ultra-minimal theme with only black and white.

## Install

```bash
npm install @intinyagroup/tokens@alpha
```

## Usage

```svelte
<script>
  import '@intinyagroup/tokens/minimalist.css';
</script>
```

## Features

- Pure black and white only
- No shadows
- No border radius
- Maximum whitespace
- Hairline borders (1px)
- System font
